description: This file defines a class RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder that implements IProviderBuilder for configuring Redis-based grain directory providers in Orleans. It includes methods to set up Redis connections via configuration, supporting both named connection multiplexers and connection strings.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring Redis grain directory providers in Orleans, supporting connection setup via service key or connection string.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Redis grain directory provider with connection details from configuration, supporting both named multiplexers and connection strings.
